scenario: Selective-import names are single identifiers per LIMP.4.2.4. Dotted forms (`from ha import light.turn_on`) are compile errors; the grammar's `import_name` production accepts only `IDENT | TYPE_NAME`, so a dotted name surfaces as an unexpected `.` token after the first identifier and rejects with DS_PARSE_GENERIC. Importable identifiers are the principal names declared at the library's top level (schemas, consts, rules, flat-named services, domains) — never an interior segment of a dotted service path.
rules_ds:
from ha import light.turn_on

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
